intro: Made for modern living, Hannah fuses sleek aesthetics and smart storage to make your space organised and stylish. From a contemporary headboard to hassle-free storage, it emits ease and elegance.

features.title: Modern aesthetics with refined linework
features.text: Sleek and stylish, Hannah’s refined design and contemporary headboard are crafted to appeal to the tastes of modern customers, blending seamlessly into any bedroom décor.

features.title: Ledged headboard for display and utility
features.text: Elevate your space with the headboard’s ledge, perfect for displaying décor or keeping daily essentials like your phone and wallet within easy reach, offering both style and convenience.

features.title: Innovative box storage with sliding panels
features.text: Forget heavy lifting. The sliding panels provide easy access to under-bed storage, making organisation effortless and efficient while keeping clutter out of sight.

features.title: Headboard with additional storage
features.text: Smart and spacious, the headboard doubles as a functional storage unit, ensuring all your belongings have a dedicated space without compromising on elegance.

features.title: Low maintenance and easy to clean
features.text: Crafted for busy lifestyles, the bed’s smooth surfaces are easy to clean, letting you enjoy a pristine and stylish bedroom with minimal effort.

name: Hannah King Size Engineered Wood Bed With Box Storage
